title: frangula rubra
intro: Frangula rubra, commonly known as Red Alder Buckthorn, is a plant species belonging to the family Rhamnaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including treating digestive issues such as constipation, diarrhea, and inflammatory bowel disease due to its ability to stimulate bowel movements and improve gut health. The therapeutic actions of Frangula rubra include its emetic, purgative, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help alleviate symptoms associated with various gastrointestinal conditions. The bioactive constituents of Frangula rubra include anthraquinones, specifically emodin and aloe-emodin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
